recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It completes the core reconciliation for FHIR-17901 while relying on the Extension Pack for workflow-episodeOfCare and preserving later no-change decisions against a core rollback.
issue_request: FHIR-17901 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested replacing the Event and Request pattern context element with encounter as Reference(Encounter) 0..1, plus defining a 0..* EpisodeOfCare workflow extension.
initial_application: Commit 633021569c4ee210837d89828831cac8764c69bd, merged by 6b8ca9c61f, applied the main workflow rename and created the workflow extension source. Current Data Elements rows already define Event.encounter and Request.encounter as Reference(Encounter), but active search worksheet paths and a later-regressed Claim workflow map still referenced Request/Event.context.
additional_context: The workflow-episodeOfCare extension now lives in the FHIR Extension Pack with value Reference(EpisodeOfCare). Later FHIR-42761 rejected rolling the Event pattern back to EpisodeOfCare in core, and FHIR-33166 only clarified Observation guidance, so the correct current model remains encounter plus extension.
reconciliation: Updated Event and Request search worksheet paths from Event/Request.context to Event/Request.encounter, restored Claim.item.encounter's workflow mapping to Request.encounter, and removed or updated stale Event.context/Request.context entries in the workflow warning suppression list. Inactive SupplyDelivery/Transport source and fhir.ini historical version maps were not edited.
